notice: Build-time installer downloads official Linux/Windows assets where available and installs distro packages where offered. Some historical entries are projects/tools rather than standalone runnable emulator binaries; consult install-report.json. No games, BIOS, firmware, keys, or copyrighted console system software are bundled.

emulators.name: KytyPS5
emulators.notes: The image attempts a best-effort Linux build of the official source; check install-report and build logs.

emulators.name: shadPS4
emulators.notes: Installer attempts to obtain a matching Linux release asset; availability depends on the upstream release format.

emulators.name: RPCS3
emulators.notes: Installer attempts the official Linux binary release repository; Debian package is a fallback.

emulators.name: DuckStation
emulators.notes: Installer searches the official upstream repository for a Linux x86_64 AppImage matching its strict allowlist; if no matching asset is published, no substitute is guessed and the profile stays unavailable unless a trusted distro package or user-supplied binary is present. The BIOS shell requires a legally obtained PS1 BIOS.

emulators.name: PCSX2
emulators.notes: Installer attempts an official Linux AppImage release; Debian package is a fallback. User must provide a legally obtained BIOS dump.

emulators.name: PPSSPP
emulators.notes: Official PPSSPP supports game emulation. Some current builds document experimental --vsh to attempt the authentic PSP XMB when a user-supplied flash0 firmware dump is available; EmuStack exposes that as an experimental system-boot target, not a guarantee of full firmware functionality.

emulators.name: Vita3K
emulators.notes: Installer attempts the official x86_64 Linux AppImage; if no matching release asset is available, the profile stays unavailable unless a trusted package or user-supplied binary is present. Experimental game compatibility; Vita3K UI is not the original LiveArea.

emulators.name: Xbox One — runner indisponível
emulators.platform: Xbox One / One S / One X
emulators.notes: Isolated placeholder only. No supported full-system Xbox One emulator/runner is integrated; all game and system launch actions are blocked. No fake executable is created.

emulators.name: Xenia Canary
emulators.notes: Installer attempts an official Windows Canary archive; Wine execution on Linux is experimental and game-dependent.

emulators.name: Xbox Series S / Series X — runner indisponível
emulators.notes: Isolated placeholder only. No supported full-system Xbox Series emulator/runner is integrated; all launch actions are blocked. No fake executable is created.

emulators.name: xemu
emulators.notes: Linux package is installed from Debian when available; otherwise this ID remains unavailable in the install report.

emulators.name: Eden
emulators.notes: Installer fetches the official amd64 AppImage from the official Eden release page; no firmware or games are included.

emulators.name: Cemu
emulators.notes: Installer attempts the official Linux AppImage; Debian package is a fallback.

emulators.name: Dolphin
emulators.notes: Installer attempts the official Linux x64 AppImage; Debian package is a fallback.

emulators.name: Azahar
emulators.notes: Official Linux AppImage is downloaded during build if available.

emulators.name: melonDS
emulators.notes: Installer attempts an official Linux AppImage; Debian package is a fallback.

emulators.name: mGBA
emulators.platform: Game Boy Advance / Game Boy / Game Boy Color
emulators.notes: Official Linux AppImage is downloaded during build if available.

emulators.name: Mupen64Plus
emulators.notes: Debian packages and plugins are installed when available; console frontend may need additional configuration.

emulators.name: bsnes

emulators.name: Mesen
